shots.text: On the Thunder Steppe the sky had never once been still. The Galeborn read the storms the way we read books.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Endless high grass under a racing sky, standing stones, tent-cities, riders on grey horses.

shots.text: Now the clouds hung motionless, and the Stone came climbing up the plateau.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: A frozen, motionless sky. Armoured earth spirits climbing the plateau edge. At their head a giant Stoneborn general with a square hole in his chest: Gorrath.
